recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further FHIR core source work is needed for FHIR-37807 unless the work group later changes the canonical distribution location for FHIR test cases.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-I R5 change request reporting that downloads.html linked to an empty HAPI org.hl7.fhir.core resources directory and the HTTP PATCH section linked to missing test-cases.zip; the resolution was to use the correct links.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentions FHIR-37807. Git history shows the old links were introduced earlier, and commit 0d58d10e724397da66de18b51936bc3c2702e4f7 changed both source/downloads.html and source/http.html to https://github.com/FHIR/fhir-test-cases/releases shortly after the 2022-08-29 FHIR-I vote.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml lists downloads.html, http.html, and fhirpatch.html as current narrative pages, and source/fhirpatch.html also uses the same fhir-test-cases releases URL. FHIR-I Confluence minutes for 2022-08-29 record FHIR-37807 as Persuasive with a 12-0-0 vote and note that Grahame would find the correct links. Direct community searches found no conflicting later discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current specification source already contains the corrected test-case links in the cited build-scope pages and in the parallel FHIRPath Patch text.
